definitions.explanation: Expressing disagreement, rejection, or denial; having a critical or unfavorable outlook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{否定的|ひていてき}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He was negative about that proposal.

examples.japanese: {否定的|ひていてき}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I wish you wouldn't only say negative things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{否定的|ひていてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There were many negative reactions at the meeting.

notes:
{否定的|ひていてき} describes a view, answer or reaction that rejects or disapproves of something. It is about judging a particular thing, not about mood: a pessimistic person is ⟦ネガティブ→ネガティブ：29634_negatibu⟧ or ⟦{悲観的|ひかんてき}→悲観的：06091_hikanteki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {否定的|ひていてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (negative attitude)
- {否定的|ひていてき}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (negative opinion)
- {否定的|ひていてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (negative reaction)
- {否定的|ひていてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捉|とら}える→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧ (to view negatively)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肯定的|こうていてき}→肯定的：06334_kouteiteki⟧: the opposite, approving or affirmative (⟦{肯定的|こうていてき}→肯定的：06334_kouteiteki⟧な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧)
- ⟦ネガティブ→ネガティブ：29634_negatibu⟧: negative in outlook or mood (⟦ネガティブ→ネガティブ：29634_negatibu⟧な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧); {否定的|ひていてき} is the more formal word for a stance against something specific
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧: passive, reluctant to act; it describes holding back, not disapproving
